title: Dev Primitive Roles Config
description: Configuration for the two-role (planner/builder) development primitive. The exact model class for each role is customizable here and drives every harness adapter.

classIds.description: Optional map from model class/alias to a concrete model id, for transports that cannot resolve the harness alias (e.g. the api access path). model.id, when set, still wins.

access.description: How the role is reached. 'harness' (default): the harness's native model selection and auth. 'api': a direct call billed to the role's provider credentials, bypassing the harness's session auth.

class.description: The customizable model class/alias for this role (e.g. fable, opus, sonnet, or a provider-specific class). Resolves to the newest model in that family on harnesses that support aliases.

id.description: Optional exact model id to pin (e.g. claude-opus-4-8). When non-empty it overrides class for resolution.

provider.description: Key into the top-level providers map.

type.description: Wire protocol / SDK family the harness should use for this provider.

apiKeyFile.description: Optional path (~ allowed) to a file holding the API key, chmod 600. Used when the apiKeyEnv variable is unset; the env var wins when both exist. Path only — never the secret itself.
